utterances.speaker: grandparent
utterances.text: I cut it up in little strips and I salt it.

utterances.speaker: grandparent
utterances.text: And then I just flour it or mill it. Sometimes I put a little mill and flour together. I like a little bit of the mill. And I put salt in that

utterances.speaker: grandparent
utterances.text: and have it in a bowl that's got a lid on it to where you can...

utterances.speaker: grandparent
utterances.text: Shake it.  I dump it upside down, up, up, up.

utterances.speaker: grandparent
utterances.text: until it's really good and then you put it in a heavy skillet, the one that you cook, I cook chicken in. And you have your bruce in there and get it real, don't have a lot of bruce now. Put it in there and you let it, I like to let it have a little brown.

utterances.speaker: grandchild
utterances.text: Yeah, I like the way you make it.

utterances.speaker: grandchild
utterances.text: And then I dump it over and let it do on the other side.
